q: Which cloud model lets a company keep sensitive workloads on-premises while bursting other workloads into a public cloud?
A hybrid cloud combines on-premises (private) infrastructure with public cloud resources, so workloads can move between them.
You pay only for the compute time your Azure Functions actually use. Which benefit of cloud computing does this describe?
Consumption-based (pay-as-you-go) pricing means you are billed for the resources you use, not for capacity you reserve.
Which Azure service provides a managed relational database based on the SQL Server engine?
Azure SQL Database is a PaaS relational database built on the SQL Server engine. Cosmos DB is a NoSQL service.
What is the smallest unit you can use to group related Azure resources for management and billing?
A resource group is a logical container for resources that share a lifecycle. Subscriptions and management groups sit above it.
Under the shared responsibility model, who is always responsible for the data stored in a SaaS application?
In every model (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) the customer remains responsible for their data, accounts and identities.
Which tool shows recommendations to reduce cost and improve security across your Azure resources?
Azure Advisor analyzes your configuration and usage and gives personalized recommendations for cost, security, reliability and performance.
Which feature lets you block the creation of resources outside approved regions?
Azure Policy evaluates resources against rules, such as allowed locations, and can deny non-compliant deployments.
An application needs a fully managed in-memory cache to reduce database read latency. Which service fits best?
ElastiCache provides managed Redis or Memcached, which serve reads from memory with sub-millisecond latency.
Which S3 storage class is the lowest-cost option for data that is rarely accessed and can wait 12 hours for retrieval?
Glacier Deep Archive has the lowest storage price, with standard retrieval within 12 hours.
A web tier must keep running if one Availability Zone fails. What should the architect do?
Deploy instances across multiple AZs behind a load balancer
Spreading instances across AZs behind an Elastic Load Balancer removes the single AZ as a point of failure.
Instances in a private subnet need outbound internet access for patches but must not accept inbound connections. What do you add?
An internet gateway on the private subnet
A NAT gateway in a public subnet
A NAT gateway in a public subnet lets private instances start outbound connections while blocking unsolicited inbound traffic.
Which service decouples components so a spike in orders does not overwhelm the processing tier?
SQS queues messages so the consumers can process them at their own pace, absorbing bursts.
Which feature lets an EC2 instance call S3 without storing access keys on the instance?
IAM user credentials in a file
An IAM role attached to the instance
An instance profile (IAM role) supplies temporary credentials automatically, so no long-term keys are stored.
An attacker sends an email that appears to come from the CEO asking finance to wire money urgently. What is this?
Impersonating an executive by email to request payments is business email compromise, a targeted form of phishing.
Which control type is a security camera that records but nobody actively watches?
Recording footage helps detect and investigate incidents after the fact, so it is a detective control.
RSA uses a public/private key pair. AES and 3DES are symmetric ciphers, and SHA-256 is a hash.
What does salting a password before hashing primarily defend against?
A unique salt makes precomputed hash tables useless because each stored hash differs even for identical passwords.
Which principle says users get only the access needed for their job?
Least privilege limits each account to the minimum permissions its role requires.
A company wants to confirm a downloaded file has not been altered. What should it compare?
Matching cryptographic hashes confirm integrity; any change to the file changes its hash.
How many usable host addresses are in a /26 subnet?
A /26 leaves 6 host bits: 2⁶ = 64 addresses, minus network and broadcast = 62 usable hosts.
Which protocol prevents Layer 2 loops between switches?
Spanning Tree Protocol blocks redundant switch paths so frames cannot loop forever.
What is the default administrative distance of OSPF?
OSPF uses 110. EIGRP internal is 90 and RIP is 120.
Which device separates broadcast domains by default?
Routers do not forward broadcasts, so each router interface is its own broadcast domain.
SSH runs on TCP 22. Telnet uses 23 and sends data in clear text.
Which command shows a summary of interface IP addresses and status on a Cisco router?
show ip interface brief lists each interface with its IP address and up/down status.
Which language do you use to create calculated measures in Power BI?
Measures are written in DAX. M is the Power Query language used for data transformation.
Which schema design does Power BI recommend for performance and simpler DAX?
A star schema with fact tables surrounded by dimension tables gives the best filtering and modeling experience.
You want report viewers to see only rows for their own region. What should you set up?
Row-level security filters data per user based on roles and DAX filter rules.
Which storage mode queries the source system every time a visual refreshes?
DirectQuery sends queries to the source at view time instead of storing a copy in the model.
Which feature keeps imported data current in the Power BI service on a schedule?
Scheduled refresh reloads imported data at set times, using a gateway for on-premises sources.
What does the CALCULATE function do in DAX?
Evaluates an expression in a modified filter context
CALCULATE changes the filter context and then evaluates the expression, which makes it the core of most measures.

n: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
q: Your team stores historical Parquet files in an Amazon S3 bucket. You want lakehouse users to query them in Fabric without copying the data. What should you create?
A OneLake shortcut points to data in another location, such as S3 or ADLS Gen2, so it appears in the lakehouse without being copied.
Which file format do Fabric lakehouse tables use by default?
Lakehouse tables are Delta tables: Parquet data files plus a transaction log that adds ACID transactions and time travel.
You need an Azure SQL Database replicated into OneLake in near real time, with no pipelines to build or maintain. What should you use?
Mirroring continuously replicates supported operational databases into OneLake as Delta tables without ETL code.
A Data Factory pipeline must copy data from a SQL Server instance in your company's own data center. What must be in place?
Fabric reaches data sources inside private on-premises networks through an on-premises data gateway installed in that network.
Which item should you use to ingest a continuous stream of IoT events into Fabric without writing code?
Eventstream captures, transforms and routes real-time event data to destinations such as an eventhouse or lakehouse.
Analysts want to query streaming telemetry with Kusto Query Language. Where should the data land?
An eventhouse hosts KQL databases, which are optimized for time-series and log data queried with KQL.
Which KQL operator groups rows and calculates aggregates such as count() or avg()?
summarize aggregates rows by the grouping columns you list, for example summarize count() by DeviceId.
A Delta table has thousands of small files and queries are slow. Which command compacts them into fewer, larger files?
OPTIMIZE rewrites many small files into larger ones, which reduces file-open overhead during reads.
What does VACUUM do on a Delta table?
Deletes data files no longer referenced and older than the retention period
VACUUM removes files that the current table version no longer uses and that are older than the retention threshold, which is 7 days by default.
Which write-time optimization applies special sorting and compression to Parquet files so Fabric engines read them faster?
V-Order is a Fabric write-time optimization for Parquet that speeds up reads by Power BI, SQL and Spark engines.
You need multi-table transactions and full T-SQL INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE support. Which item should you use?
A Fabric warehouse supports T-SQL DML and multi-table transactions. A lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint is read-only.
A user tries to run UPDATE through a lakehouse's SQL analytics endpoint. What happens?
The statement fails because the endpoint is read-only
The update is queued for Spark
The table is converted to a warehouse table
The SQL analytics endpoint allows reads only. Lakehouse tables are changed with Spark or by loading data, not with T-SQL DML.
A developer must create and edit items in a workspace but must not manage workspace access. Which role follows least privilege?
Contributors can create and edit items. Members can also share and add people, and Admins manage everything.
Which language does Dataflow Gen2 use for its transformations?
Dataflow Gen2 is built on Power Query, so its transformations are Power Query M steps, usually authored in a visual editor.
Which pipeline activity runs a Fabric notebook as one step of an orchestration?
The Notebook activity runs a notebook and can pass parameters to it from the pipeline.
A pipeline must run the same Copy activity once for each table name in a list. Which activity should wrap it?
ForEach iterates over an array, such as table names returned by a Lookup, and runs its inner activities for each item.
You load only new or changed rows from a source table each night. What does this pattern usually rely on?
A watermark column such as LastModifiedDate
Reading the entire source every time
Incremental loads keep the last processed watermark value and query only rows changed after it.
Which Delta Lake operation inserts new rows and updates matching rows in a single statement?
MERGE INTO matches source rows to target rows on a key, updating matches and inserting the rest, which is an upsert.
A dimension must keep the full history of a customer's address changes. Which approach fits?
Type 2 adds a new row for each change, with effective dates or a current flag, so earlier versions are kept.
In a medallion architecture, which layer holds cleaned and conformed data that is not yet aggregated for reporting?
Bronze holds raw data, Silver holds cleaned and validated data, and Gold holds business-level aggregates.
You need to promote Fabric items from development to test to production workspaces. What should you use?
Deployment pipelines move content between stage workspaces and let you set rules, such as different data sources per stage.
Which feature connects a Fabric workspace to Azure DevOps or GitHub for version control?
Workspace Git integration syncs supported items to a branch so you can commit, branch and review changes.
Where can you see the status and history of pipeline, notebook and dataflow runs across workspaces?
The Monitoring hub lists recent activity runs with their status, duration and owner.
You need to find which workloads consume the most capacity units on an F64 capacity. What should you use?
The Capacity Metrics app reports capacity unit consumption, throttling and the items driving usage.
In a Fabric warehouse, how do you limit each salesperson to rows for their own region?
Row-level security with a security policy and predicate function
Row-level security uses an inline table-valued function as a filter predicate, applied by CREATE SECURITY POLICY.
Support staff may query a customer table but must see email addresses only partially, such as aXX@XXXX.com. What should you configure?
Dynamic data masking obscures column values in query results for users without the UNMASK permission.
Which statement prevents a user from reading the Salary column while still reading the other columns of a warehouse table?
GRANT SELECT on the permitted columns only
Column-level security grants SELECT on specific columns, so queries touching Salary fail for that user.
Notebook sessions take too long to start for small, frequent jobs. Which Spark option gives the fastest start with default settings?
A custom pool with large nodes
Starter pools keep live clusters ready, so sessions with default settings usually start in seconds.
Several notebooks need the same Python libraries and Spark properties. Where should you define them once?
An environment item holds libraries, Spark compute and configuration, and you attach it to notebooks or to the workspace.
A Delta table is filtered by OrderDate in most queries. Which design helps queries skip irrelevant files?
Partition or cluster the table by date
Partitioning or clustering by a commonly filtered column lets the engine prune files outside the filter range.
A Spark Structured Streaming job writes to a Delta table. What must you provide so it restarts without reprocessing data?
A watermark column in the source
The checkpoint location stores stream progress and state, so a restarted query resumes where it stopped.
You want an email when sensor temperature exceeds a threshold in streaming data, without writing code. What should you use?
Activator monitors data, such as an eventstream, and fires actions like emails or Teams messages when conditions are met.
A pipeline must send a Teams message only when a Copy activity fails. How do you set this up?
Connect the message activity to the Copy activity's On fail path
Add it at the start of the pipeline
Activity dependencies have Success, Fail, Completion and Skip paths. The On fail path runs only after a failure.
Which notebook magic command lets you run Spark SQL in a cell of a PySpark notebook?
%%sql switches that cell to Spark SQL, so you can query lakehouse tables with SQL.
Which command shows the versions, operations and timestamps recorded for a Delta table?
DESCRIBE HISTORY reads the transaction log and lists each table version with its operation and time, which supports time travel.
Where should you land raw source files, such as JSON exports, in a lakehouse before converting them to tables?
The Files section stores unmanaged files in any format. You then load or transform them into Delta tables in Tables.
